definitions.explanation: The hair that grows on the brow ridge above the eye.

examples.japanese: {眉毛|まゆげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
{眉毛|まゆげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{眉毛|まゆげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: I shaved my eyebrows too much and ended up with a funny-looking face.

notes:
{眉毛|まゆげ} refers to the hair on the brow ridge above the eye.

FORMS:
⟦{眉|まゆ}→眉：04267_mayu⟧ (brow) + ⟦{毛|げ}→毛：01392_ke⟧ (hair). ⟦{眉|まゆ}→眉：04267_mayu⟧ alone can also mean eyebrow.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {眉毛|まゆげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to groom eyebrows
- {眉毛|まゆげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw on eyebrows (makeup)
- {眉毛|まゆげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave eyebrows
- {眉毛|まゆげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to pluck eyebrows
- {眉毛|まゆげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧/⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: thick/thin eyebrows
- ⟦{眉|まゆ}をひそめる→眉をひそめる：06897_mayuwohisomeru⟧: to frown, to show displeasure
- ⟦{眉|まゆ}{唾|つば}→眉唾：28820_mayutsuba⟧: dubious, suspicious (lit. "brow spit")

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{眉間|みけん}→眉間：08540_miken⟧: the space between the eyebrows
